description: Ratchet baseline for the a11y gate (WCAG 2.2 AA floor). Per `<route>@<width>`, the axe rules (by id, impact critical or serious) this product currently tolerates. Empty list = no tolerance, which is the desired and current state. Adding an id here is a conscious, diff-reviewable decision: write the reason alongside, as `<route>@<width>: <id> — <why>`. The ratchet moves both ways: an id that fires without being listed here fails, and an id that is listed here but no longer fires also fails.
